method: Native pinned MiniLM, 384 dimensions, .3 threshold, first 500 title/claim characters and 256 tokens, short-query scale 11/12, eight records and stable 36-hour claim age. Existing suites unchanged; baseline rows copied byte-for-byte from their accepted prior final runs. New baselines scored with the immutable 457a5d0 executable. New development complete-answer gains selected before reserved candidate scoring; no tuning from reserved outcomes.

validation.native_recall_evaluation: all compared views passed committed per-record comparator
validation.tests: Focused Rust oversized-title bound/rollback contract passed with 90 visible oversized alternatives; evaluator effective-input cache contract passed. Other crate/frontend tests, clippy and final format check skipped.
validation.formatting: Changed Rust files formatted with rustfmt; changed root/docs/eval files formatted with Prettier.

evaluator_cache_contract.scope: Positive character-window cache, exact Unicode boundary, changed prefixes remain distinct.

validation.full_oversized_stress: All 120 cases, lexical and hybrid, development and reserved, 1000/2000-token allowances; all per-record regression audits passed.

limitations: Synthetic verbose alternatives for eight reused exposed incidents; correlated repeated policy/budget views are not independent validation.
The content-only bound is necessary, not sufficient; full-plan rendering and protected-claim checks remain authoritative.
Oversized matching incumbents can still occupy protected positions and prevent optional title completion. No global short-claim preference, truncation or incumbent replacement was added.
Capacity controls require 15 facts with eight slots and are excluded from headline recall.
Known-symbol negative controls can still inject records; this report measures unchanged negative packet identities, not general abstention quality.
No new paired real-agent tasks or latency benchmark. Existing release-quality gate is unchanged.
Two focused contracts were run for the requested oversized-alternative coverage; broader automated tests remain skipped. Evaluation preservation is scoped to the replayed corpus.

stress.requested: Execute all oversized alternatives; native case coverage in addition to the focused Rust contract.
stress.expansion: For every source corpus record tagged oversized-archive, emit 90 records indexed n=0..89 with all fields unchanged except content = record.content + newline + Archive copy n. All other corpus records and every case are unchanged. Serialize with JSON.stringify(data) and no trailing newline.
stress.selection: Requested stress expansion after candidate selection. Runtime and expected facts frozen; stress outcomes did not retune the implementation. Independent native processes may run concurrently; not a latency benchmark.

evaluator_cache.policy: Key by exactly the positive declared character prefix; unknown/unbounded providers keep full-text keys. Only evaluator memoization changes.
